stories.title: Teacher’s jail term for sexual assault raised from 6 to 10 years

stories.title: Unsubsidised fuel prices drop across the board for 2nd week in a row

stories.title: MP calls for more funding, expertise as Malaysia explores nuclear power
stories.summary: Wan Ahmad Fayhsal Wan Ahmad Kamal urges greater funding for MyPower and the involvement of retired specialists and nuclear-trained Malaysians now working in unrelated fields.

stories.title: Thai minister rejects full tariff cuts on US goods, contradicting Trump

stories.title: Ringgit weakens as hawkish US rate outlook weighs
stories.summary: Traders continue to assess the outlook for monetary policy in 2026, focusing on the US Federal Open Market Committee meeting scheduled for Dec 8-9, says an analyst.

stories.title: Nvidia says no longer shipping ‘Hopper’ AI chips to China

stories.title: Bursa ends lower as cautious sentiment weighs on selected heavyweights

stories.title: UK inflation rises to one-year high of 3.6%

stories.title: China’s AI stocks, hyperscalers hit by signs of tougher US tech curbs
